title: Factorial ratio growth order
statement: Fix a positive natural number $r$. As $k$ tends to infinity through the natural numbers, the function $\\frac{(rk)!}{(k!)^r r^{rk}}$ has the same order of growth, up to positive constant factors, as $k^{(1-r)/2}$.
